ClaimEvidence.description: A primary-source quotation retained locally for an independently checkable claim.
ClaimEvidence.title: ClaimEvidence

CrossCorpusLink.description: A directed link from the containing record or sub-object to a record in another Mech corpus. The five field names preserve NaturalProductMech's existing link shape. Consumers define allowed relations and evidence requirements; this class alone does not verify a target, its version, organism scope, or the scientific basis of the relation.

basis.description: How the relation was established, for example SAME_INCHIKEY for an exact chemical-structure join. A match on a protein or reaction must not be presented as sufficient evidence for a stronger relation.

corpus.description: Canonical target corpus name, for example PathwayMech or AntibioticMech.

identifier.description: Target record identifier, verbatim, in the named corpus.

relation.description: Directed relation from the containing record or sub-object to the target. Consumers may constrain this string with a local enum through slot_usage on a subclass, without changing the shared module.

source_version.description: Pinned commit or release of the target corpus that was checked. Optional for compatibility with existing NaturalProductMech links; consumers should require a full immutable version for newly added links.

CrossCorpusLink.title: CrossCorpusLink

CurationEvent.description: Generated record-level view of a canonical sidecar event; the referenced history record is authoritative.

timestamp.description: Preserve the canonical UTC timestamp spelling and precision through model serialization.

CurationEvent.title: CurationEvent

Dataset.description: A reference to a publicly available dataset (omics, sequence, phenotype) relevant to this record. A lightweight repository-accession reference, not a full Datasheets-for-Datasets / DCAT description.

accession.description: Repository accession or CURIE, e.g. `geo:GSE36701`, `NCBI_SRA:SRP...`. (CultureMech `dataset_id` migrates here.)

description.description: Human-readable description; may add nuance beyond the title.

findings.description: Brief note on what the dataset shows relevant to this record.

organism.description: Source organism / community label (free text or CURIE).

sample_types.description: Sample/material types represented (free text or term labels).

url.description: Direct URL to the dataset landing page, if no CURIE applies.

Dataset.title: Dataset

DatasetRepositoryEnum.description: Public repository hosting the dataset. Superset of CommunityMech's enum (all values preserved) plus common additions; CultureMech datasets have no repository field today and migrate with repository unset / OTHER.
DatasetRepositoryEnum.title: DatasetRepositoryEnum

DatasetTypeEnum.description: Type of dataset or data resource. Canonical UNION of CultureMech's and CommunityMech's enums plus microbial additions. Migration map (old → this): CultureMech values carry over unchanged; CommunityMech GENOME→GENOMICS, METAGENOME→METAGENOMICS, METATRANSCRIPTOME→METATRANSCRIPTOMICS, METAPROTEOME→METAPROTEOMICS (AMPLICON_16S / AMPLICON_ITS / METABOLOMICS / PHENOTYPE / MULTI_OMICS / OTHER are unchanged).
DatasetTypeEnum.title: DatasetTypeEnum

Discussion.description: A thread-like record of an open question, controversy, curation todo, emerging hypothesis, knowledge gap, or interpretation debate attached to a record or one of its sub-objects. Captures the discourse / knowledge-gap layer of curation. External thread links (GitHub issues, forum posts) are cited via the `evidence` block, not a separate slot.

attaches_to.description: Hash-anchor pointers into the sections/nodes this discussion concerns: `<section>#<anchor>`, e.g. `causal_graphs#edge_x`, `composition#ingredient_y`, `ecological_interactions#z`, `ontology_mapping#m`. Free-form so each Mech can anchor into its own record structure.

discussion_id.description: Stable local identifier for this discussion thread.

posed_by.description: Curator or agent that raised the discussion.

prompt.description: The open question, gap statement, or todo, in one or two sentences.

proposed_experiments.description: Optional sketches of how the gap could be resolved.

rationale.description: Why this matters / what resolving it would change.

resolution_note.description: How it was resolved (when status is RESOLVED).

Discussion.title: Discussion

DiscussionKindEnum.description: Kind of unresolved / in-progress item captured by a Discussion. Knowledge gaps are represented as a discussion kind so they reuse the shared pointer, evidence, and lifecycle machinery, while optional proposed experiments capture how a gap could be resolved.
DiscussionKindEnum.title: DiscussionKindEnum

FamilyCuration.description: Human-owned overlay. Imported identity and counters cannot be overridden.
FamilyCuration.title: FamilyCuration

FamilyRecord.description: A source-derived family projection; SEEDED is not scientific review.

curation_events.description: Read-only index derived from validated canonical history sidecars, never an authoring surface.

curation_history.description: Stable directory containing canonical append-only history for this family.

description.description: Imported source description, not a verified functional assertion.

review_id.description: Retained completed record report; required with matching content and history for REVIEWED.

FamilyRecord.title: FamilyRecord

FunctionalAssertion.description: Scoped experimental or computational claim, not implied by a DUF name.

scope.description: Exact family/subfamily/protein scope and limits of generalization.

FunctionalAssertion.title: FunctionalAssertion

ProposedExperiment.description: A lightweight, domain-neutral sketch of an experiment or analysis that could resolve a knowledge gap. Records the idea and how its outcome would decide the gap; intentionally simpler than a full study design.

approach.description: Method/assay in brief (e.g. "defined-coculture growth assay", "isolate WGS").

decision_criterion.description: The observation that would settle the question.

model_systems.description: Systems to use (e.g. isolate, enrichment, defined coculture, metagenome).

perturbations.description: Interventions applied (e.g. gene knockout, nutrient removal).

would_support.description: Outcome that would support the hypothesis/assertion.

ProposedExperiment.title: ProposedExperiment

source_url.description: Upstream URL when the snapshot is acquired rather than locally derived.

SupportLevelEnum.description: How a SupportingReference bears on the claim it is attached to (mirrors the supports semantics already used in the Mech EvidenceItem models).
SupportLevelEnum.title: SupportLevelEnum

SupportingReference.description: A lightweight literature/database citation supporting a Discussion or Dataset. Self-contained (so this module has no dependency on each repo's EvidenceItem); carries a verbatim `snippet` so the same anti-hallucination snippet-vs-cached-abstract check the Mechs already run can validate it.

evidence_source.description: How the snippet was obtained (e.g. abstract, full_text, figure, supplement, database). Free-form to stay self-contained.

explanation.description: Why this source bears on the claim.

reference.description: PMID:..., DOI:..., a repository accession/CURIE, or an opaque URL.

reference_title.description: Title of the cited source (optional; populated by tooling).

snippet.description: Verbatim quote from the source supporting the attached claim.

SupportingReference.title: SupportingReference

description: A source-derived family projection; SEEDED is not scientific review.

curation_events.description: Read-only index derived from validated canonical history sidecars, never an authoring surface.

curation_history.description: Stable directory containing canonical append-only history for this family.

description.description: Imported source description, not a verified functional assertion.

review_id.description: Retained completed record report; required with matching content and history for REVIEWED.
